item.title: Log in and Enter a Federated Project
item.description: This section describes how to log in to the KubeSphere web console and enter a federated project. Prerequisites The KubeSphere platform must have the Federated Application Management extension installed and enabled. You need to obtain the username and password of a federated project member. Method 1 Log in to the KubeSphere web console and enter your workspace. In the left navigation pane, click Federated Projects to enter the Federated Projects page.
